messages:
sara_cust: Hey team — our private agent fails when generating the debug bundle. Collector logs show a redaction error then the upload presign returns 403. Happening on our staging box only.

mike_support: Sorry to hear that. Can you paste the collector log around the failure and the request ID from the upload attempt? Also which agent version?

sara_cust: Agent v2.14.1. Upload error excerpt: `upload: presign returned status=403 body={\"error\":\"pre-sign invalid\"}`. Request id in that response header: `x-rw-req: rq_9f2b3a4c`. Log snippet: ```
2026-03-15T09:12:03Z collector: start bundle generation
2026-03-15T09:12:07Z redact: warning: xpath-missing field user.email -> skipping
2026-03-15T09:12:09Z redact: error: redaction pipeline failed: REDACT_ERROR: unexpected token
2026-03-15T09:12:09Z collector: aborting bundle (code 78)
2026-03-15T09:12:10Z uploader: presign request -> 403 (rq_9f2b3a4c)
```

mike_support: OK thanks. Two threads: (1) redaction failing mid-pipeline, (2) presign 403. For repro please run the curl below from the same host (it hits the private control plane presign endpoint) and paste response + headers. Use your real API key.

mike_support: ```
curl -i -X POST 'https://private-api.redwood.example/v1/collector/presign' \ 
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $PRIVATE_API_KEY' \ 
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \ 
  -d '{"bundle_size": 5242880, "manifest_checksum": "<sha256_hex>", "agent_version": "2.14.1"}'
```

anna_eng: tagging in — the SHA mismatch we saw earlier was caused by a signed-manifest v2 signer rotation on 2026-03-14. If the collector is still producing v1-style manifests the server will reject with 403. Can you `sha256sum` the generated manifest and paste result?

jem: also check that the collector has `redaction.config` in the same dir as the manifest. The xpath warning suggests a config drift. On v2 collectors we changed the default config location.

sara_cust: sha256 of manifest from staging host: `d2b6a1f4c9e8f2e3f6a5b4c3d2e1f0a9b8c7d6e5f4a3b2c1d0e9f8a7b6c5d4e3`. Server presign response headers: `x-rw-req: rq_9f2b3a4c`, `x-rw-signer: signer-v2`, body: `{"error":"manifest checksum mismatch"}`.

mike_support: that confirms signer-v2 expects a different canonicalization (we recently started normalizing timestamps when computing checksum). If your collector is producing raw manifest without normalization, checksums won't match. Two options: (A) upgrade agent to 2.15.0 which includes canonicalization patch, or (B) run the helper to normalize your manifest locally before upload.

anna_eng: I can backfill a temporary presign fallback that accepts both checksums for this customer while they upgrade. Need approval from security -> @ops-bot can you create an interim ACL entry for signer-v2: allow-presign=staging-cust-42 for 48h?

ops-bot: Ticket created: SUP-4829. Temporary presign ACL requested for `staging-cust-42`. Waiting for security approval. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

mike_support: For the redaction error: can you run the local debug collector invocation with verbose and pipe the redaction output? Example command: `collector debug-run --manifest ./manifest.json --redact-config ./redaction.yaml --verbose 2>&1 | tee redact.log` and paste the tail 40 lines.

sara_cust: running now — output tail below: ```
...
2026-03-15T09:11:58Z redact: loading redaction.yaml (found)
2026-03-15T09:12:01Z redact: applying rule #12 xpath=/user/contact/email -> ok
2026-03-15T09:12:02Z redact: applying rule #13 xpath=/session/metadata -> error: xpath compile failed at token 'metadata['
2026-03-15T09:12:02Z redact: pipeline abort (rule #13) -> REDACT_ERROR
```

jem: looks like a stray `[]` in their redaction.yaml (maybe copy/paste from example with samples). If you remove the bracket or escape it, redaction should proceed. Quick fix: replace `metadata[]` with `metadata` or `metadata/*` depending on intent.

sara_cust: changed config to `metadata/*` and re-ran collector. Redaction now passes and bundle generated, but upload still getting 403 with same x-rw-req.

mike_support: Great progress on redaction. For the 403 after fix — since manifest checksum won't change (normalization needed) either upgrade or run the normalization script locally: `scripts/normalize-manifest --in manifest.json --out manifest.norm.json` then `sha256sum manifest.norm.json` and use that checksum when calling presign.

anna_eng: I've pushed a temporary check to accept the unhashed manifest for SUP-4829 while security approves. If ops-bot gets green, try presigning again in ~5m.

ops-bot: ACL update applied for `staging-cust-42` (48h). Actioned by ops on behalf of mike_support. :white_check_mark:

sara_cust: presign POST now returns 200 and uploader started. Upload completed. Thanks all! :raised_hands:

mike_support: Awesome — recommend upgrading to 2.15.0 and removing the local normalization hack. I'll leave SUP-4829 open until you confirm upgrade.

sara_cust: Will upgrade this week and confirm here. Thanks again.

deploy-bot: Logged artifact: collector-2.15.0 at sha256:fd12... (release notes: canonicalize manifest checksums)

mike_support: marking thread resolved for now, please reopen if anything else pops up. :thumbsup:
